'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[Kasanga massacre]]
***Militants from an [[Islamic State – Central Africa Province|IS–Central Africa]]-aligned faction of the [[Allied Democratic Forces]] enter the village of Mayba in [[Lubero Territory]], [[North Kivu]], Democratic Republic of the Congo, abducting and [[behead]]ing at least 70 Christian civilians. [https://www.genocidewatch.com/single-post/70-christians-murdered-by-isis-affiliate-in-eastern-drc (Genocide Watch)]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
***[[2025 Bukavu offensive]]
****[[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] capture [[Kalehe Territory]] and Ihusi, [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], leading to several [[civilian]] casualties and the [[mass evacuation]] of residents. [https://www.bbc.com/gahuza/articles/c627y43r615o (BBC Gahuza)]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
****More than thirty [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|IS–Somalia]] fighters are killed in [[airstrike]]s on positions in the Sheebaab area of the [[Cal Miskaad]] mountains in northern [[Bari Region]], [[Puntland]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200230/new_airstrikes_in_somalia_s_puntland_kill_more_than_30_daesh_fighters.aspx (Hiiraan Online)] [http://v.aa.com.tr/3480301 (Anadolu Agency)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]], [[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***[[Hamas]] says it will resume the release of [[hostage]]s according to the terms of the [[ceasefire]] and hostage release deal with [[Israel]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hamas-to-release-israeli-hostages-per-gaza-ceasefire/ (CBS News)]
*[[2025 Munich car attack]]
**At least 28 people are injured by a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] during a [[political demonstration|demonstration]] by the [[ver.di]] [[trade union]] in [[Munich]], [[Germany]]. [[Polizeipräsidium München|Police]] arrest the vehicle's driver, a 24-year-old man, at the scene on suspicion of [[Islamic terrorism]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/munich-latest-major-police-operation-after-car-drives-into-crowd-in-german-city-13308334 (Sky News)] [https://www.newarab.com/news/afghan-arrested-after-car-ramming-attack-injures-28-germany (''New Arab'')] [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/german-authorities-say-they-are-investigating-possible-islamic-extremist-motive-for-munich-car-ramming-attack (PBS)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[German economic crisis (2022–present)|German economic crisis]]
**[[Germany|German]] [[automobile industry|automotive manufacturer]] [[Porsche]] announces it will cut 2,000 jobs over the next five years, reducing its workforce by 15%, primarily affecting its [[assembly plant]]s in [[Zuffenhausen|Stuttgart-Zuffenhausen]] and [[Weissach]] in [[Baden-Wurttemberg]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-porsche-set-to-slash-jobs-by-2029/a-69581927 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Taichung Shin Kong Mitsukoshi gas explosion]]
**Four people are killed and thirty-two others are injured by a [[gas explosion]] at a [[Shin Kong Mitsukoshi]] [[department store]] in [[Taichung]], [[Taiwan]]. [https://focustaiwan.tw/society/202502130009 (Central News Agency)]
*At least 21 people are injured, including 10 seriously, in a fire inside of a costume factory in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.bssnews.net/international/246194 (Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha)]
*Three people are dead and 114 others fall ill, including two in critical condition, after a [[gastroenteritis]] outbreak at four [[hospice]]s in [[Florence]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.ansa.it/amp/toscana/notizie/2025/02/13/intossicazione-alimentare-in-4-rsa-tre-morti-a-firenze_9231de55-299f-48a6-ba69-f75c09143156.html (Ansa)]
*At least one person is killed and three others are injured by an [[explosion]] at the [[Ministry of Urban Development and Housing (Afghanistan)|Ministry of Urban Development and Housing]] compound in [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]]. The [[Taliban government]] alleges that it was a [[suicide attack]], while no party has claimed responsibility. [https://www.dw.com/en/afghanistan-apparent-suicide-blast-targets-ministry-complex/a-71591784 (DW)]
*The [[United_States_Sixth_Fleet|US Navy Sixth Fleet]] announces that the [[Nimitz-class]] aircraft carrier [[USS Harry S. Truman]] was involved in a collision at sea with the merchant vessel Besiktas-M on February 12 while operating in the vicinity of [[Port Said, Egypt]], in the [[Mediterranean Sea]]. [https://www.c6f.navy.mil/Press-Room/News/Article/4065260/uss-harry-s-truman-involved-in-collision-at-sea/ (U.S. Sixth Fleet Public Affairs)]
*24 people are killed and 30 others are injured when a bus and truck crashed into eachover in [[Beitbridge]], [[Zimbabwe]]. <ref>https://apnews.com/article/bus-accident-deaths-0b2dbdba71e232efbb7c70f4f117eeec</ref>

'''International relations'''
*[[International Criminal Court arrest warrants for Israeli leaders]]
**The [[United States Department of the Treasury|United States Treasury Department]] [[sanctions (law)|sanctions]] [[Karim Ahmad Khan]], the top [[prosecutor]] at the [[International Criminal Court]], over his decision to [[International Criminal Court investigation in Palestine|investigate]] [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Defense Minister]] [[Yoav Gallant]] regarding their conduct during the Gaza war. [https://ofac.treasury.gov/recent-actions/20250213 (U.S. Treasury Department)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Investigations into the Eric Adams administration]]
**Acting [[U.S. Attorney]] [[Danielle Sassoon]] and five other [[U.S. Justice Department]] officials [[resign]] after being ordered by the [[second Trump administration]] to drop a federal [[corruption in the United States|corruption]] case against [[New York City]] [[Mayor of New York City|Mayor]] [[Eric Adams]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/02/13/politics/danielle-sassoon-eric-adams-us-attorney/index.html (CNN)]
*The [[Royal Thai Army]] announces that 260 foreigners have been rescued from online scam centers in [[Myanmar]] near [[Myanmar–Thailand border|the two countries' border]], where they were trafficked to and forced to work in. [https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-scam-centers-thailand-army-myawaddy-trafficking-853f556f08a2bacb3991589fc8ab3588 (AP)]
*A van carrying members of the [[Union of Indigenous Communities of the Isthmus Region]] is ambushed near Río del Sol, in the limits of the municipalities of [[Santo Domingo Petapa]] and [[San Juan Mazatlán]], leaving three local activists dead. The attack happened during the escalation of a local agrarian conflict. [https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/estados/2025/2/13/emboscada-deja-muertos-en-los-limites-de-santo-domingo-petapa-san-juan-mazatlan-oaxaca-345581.html (Revista Proceso)]
